headline: UN Commission of Inquiry says Israel continues genocide in Gaza after ceasefire
dek: The UN Commission says Israel continues genocide in Gaza after the ceasefire; Israel rejected the allegations as scandalous. Medical sources put the war toll at 74,555 killed and 175,727 wounded, with 1,559 killed and 5,608 injured since the US-brokered ceasefire took effect Oct 11 2025.
sources: UN Independent International Commission of Inquiry (statement, via Outlookindia) + Al Jazeera reporting of Monday Khan Younis strike + Nasser Hospital source via Anadolu/Daily Sabah
fault_line: Ceasefire in name only? The toll since Oct 11 2025 is the argument both sides now fight over.

sections.what_happened: The UN Commission says Israel continues genocide in Gaza after the ceasefire; Israel rejected the allegations as scandalous. Medical sources put the war toll at 74,555 killed and 175,727 wounded, with 1,559 killed and 5,608 injured since the US-brokered ceasefire took effect Oct 11 2025. Separately, an Israeli strike on a displacement camp in Khan Younis on Monday killed 4 Palestinians including a young girl (Al Jazeera via Outlookindia; Daily Sabah via Nasser Hospital/Anadolu: bodies of two young men and a girl brought to Nasser Hospital after airstrike/gunfire in Bir 19 west of Khan Younis, 14 injured across Gaza Monday). Palestinian Civil Defence: 11 killed and 50 injured across Gaza in the prior 24 hours (via Outlookindia).
sections.what_verified: Al Jazeera T2 STATE(QA) for the Monday strike; Daily Sabah T3 (+ Anadolu T3 STATE(TR) chain) for the same incident; UN Commission is a T1-class official body for its own statement (registry: UN bodies T1)
sections.what_disputed: Israel rejected the Commission's allegations as scandalous (Outlookindia); the IDF's position on specific strikes (e.g. that targets were militants) was recorded for the weekend Gaza deaths at 0400-03 - no IDF response to the Monday Bir 19 incident was found in this scan. Toll figures are medical-source counts, not independently audited.
sections.why_matters: The ceasefire's own ledger: 1,559 killed since it began, says the medical count behind the UN Commission's new charge. Lead with the number, carry Israel's rejection in full.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Outlookindia Oct 27 06:50 ; Daily Sabah Oct 26) -- UN Commission of Inquiry says Israel continues genocide in Gaza after ceasefire; medical sources: 1,559 killed since Oct 11 2025 ceasefire, total 74,555 killed / 175,727 wounded; Monday Khan Younis displacement-camp strike killed 4 incl. a young girl

totw_analysis: Our read: The ceasefire's own ledger: 1,559 killed since it began, says the medical count behind the UN Commission's new charge. Lead with the number, carry Israel's rejection in full. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Ceasefire in name only? The toll since Oct 11 2025 is the argument both sides now fight over.
